# Monokai Ristretto

Monokai Ristretto is a warm, dark Monokai-inspired palette with coffee-toned hues. Syntax highlighting is tuned for code blocks and inline code, and the interface keeps consistent colors in a minimal, distraction-free arrangement.

![Monokai Ristretto screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinitkumar/monokai-ristretto-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Monokai Ristretto"
    author: "vinitkumar"
    repo:   "vinitkumar/monokai-ristretto-obsidian"
    slug:   "monokai-ristretto"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/monokai-ristretto"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/vinitkumar/monokai-ristretto-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vinitkumar/monokai-ristretto-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a warm, dark Monokai-inspired palette with coffee-toned hues and vibrant syntax highlighting optimized for code blocks and inline code. Keep a minimal, distraction-free interface with consistent colors across the editor and UI."
}
```
